name: Diploma Fashion Design
title: Diploma in Fashion Design
intro: The fashion design diploma roadmap: admission, design and garment construction, internships and careers.

phases.title: Eligibility
phases.summary: Class 10 or 12 pass in any stream.
points: Fashion design diplomas are offered by polytechnics and private design schools.
Sketching and sense of colour help, but they can be developed during the course.
Observe clothing, fabrics and trends.
Start a sketchbook.

phases.title: Admission process
points: Apply to institutes with an aptitude test and portfolio review.
Check labs, sewing and pattern studios.
Compare fees, placement and exposure to industry.
Confirm admission with fees.

phases.title: Design basics and fabrics
points: Learn drawing, fashion illustration and colour theory.
Study fabrics, fibres and textile properties.
Practise sewing and basic garment construction.
Learn the history of fashion.

phases.title: Pattern making and collection
phases.summary: Pattern making, draping and collection design.
points: Learn pattern making, grading and draping.
Use design software such as CorelDraw, Illustrator and Photoshop.
Design a collection from concept to garment.
Learn costing and merchandising basics.

phases.title: Internship and careers
phases.summary: Workplace experience, then jobs or entrepreneurship.
points: Intern with boutiques, export houses or fashion brands.
Roles: assistant designer, pattern maker, merchandiser, stylist and boutique owner.
Further study: B.Des or advanced diplomas.
Start your own label with online selling.
